data.text: Closed by its own second outcome: fewer than five booked, reason written. The 'fewer than five' paragraph is now in docs/research/probe-b-candidates.md: ~18 touches, 2 replies, 1 opt-out, 0 booked, all from the ledger via strategy §1. The four criteria (tests first, npm test, typecheck, timing) are the engineering defaults and cannot be checked on a recruiting task. They stay unchecked on purpose; see the 2026-09-16 note. The real closing check was T50's: candidates file exists, plus five booked or the why-not paragraph. Both hold.
